Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world . 
 We are looking for: 
 We are looking for a Linux System Administrator (L2 Support) to join an international IT operations team. You will be responsible for supporting Linux production environments, resolving incidents, maintaining system stability, and contributing to continuous service improvement within an ITIL-driven environment.
 What you will do: 
Monitor Linux production environments and handle operational alerts.
Investigate and resolve Level 2 incidents while ensuring SLA compliance.
Install, configure, and maintain Linux systems and related tools.
Support production changes and perform functional testing.
Create and improve technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge base articles.
Identify recurring issues and contribute to continuous service improvement.
Collaborate with stakeholders and provide operational support within an ITIL-driven environment.
 What you must have: 
Previous experience in a Linux L2 Support or Linux System Administration role.
Strong knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) , including Kernel administration and LVM .
Experience with Red Hat Satellite .
Experience with Veritas Cluster Server and GPFS .
Hands-on experience with Ansible and ELK Stack .
Good understanding of infrastructure technologies, including: Networking, Storage, Virtualization (primarily VMware), Security principles.
Experience working in production environments and managing incidents.
Familiarity with ITIL methodologies and operational processes.
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
Very good command of English (written and spoken).
French language skills are considered an advantage.
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package.
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills.
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything. they do and understand the importance of team spirit.
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things.
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do.
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of teams.
